items.body: Take WELFARE-BID-READINESS. The useful outcome is a provider’s concrete qualification/submission checklist or an authoritative resolution of the existing malformed-route uncertainty. Inspect only already-cited official routes and two directly linked pages; do not reopen tender discovery, CSV research or blocked marketplace access. Check access before substantial extraction. If no additional authoritative material is accessible, stop this bounded attempt without generic copy or speculative criteria. Keep current public sites unchanged; no demand or revenue claim follows from this work.

Take WELFARE-READINESS-PUBLICATION. Existing research is finished: make its useful verified findings accessible to providers instead of repeating failed portal fetches. Prepare the small supplement and exact-digest review handoff; do not deploy or expand the offer. Read original evidence yourself and correct ambiguous language in the saved note, especially suitability versus eligibility and unknown registration requirements. No additional CSV or unlisted Actor work. Publication is an offer improvement, not evidence of acquisition or revenue.

Take SHOPIFY-CATALOGUE-TRANSFORMATION as one bounded delivery-fit test, not another generic validator or marketplace scan. Check the actual FETCH receipts before relying on files. The decisive question is whether a useful exact transformation is specified and deliverable through existing plain-text offline fulfillment. Do not infer willingness to pay from a pricing page or claim Shopify import compatibility without execution. If the official specification is inaccessible or the job depends on account access, stop without speculative implementation. Leave existing live sites unchanged.

Finish SHOPIFY-VARIANT-DEMAND from the successful community fetch and source inspection after reading their actual receipts. Reddit was refused HTTP 403; do not retry or bypass it. Verify dates, distinct requests and unresolved status from actual source content; search snippets alone cannot establish unresolved demand. Do not count usernames, adjacent topics, paid-tool offers or synthetic fixtures as buyer requests. If the community page is only a shell or lacks enough evidence, save STOP with that precise limitation; do not broaden discovery. CONTINUE requires five distinct supported requests within the last 24 months. Read the saved final artifact before closure using the returned valid lease and a lesson. Preserve live sites and observation deadlines; no speculative additional build, outreach or revenue claims.

SHOPIFY-COMMUNITY-DEMAND concluded STOP with two qualifying requests, below the predefined five-request threshold. Park catalogue-transformation: no further searches, speculative offer publication or implementation. Preserve its useful memo. Existing CSV and welfare windows remain open; three unclassified feedback sources do not establish zero demand. New effort is assigned to ACQUISITION for a bounded check of existing inbound routing and delivery context, without reading private mail or claiming classification occurred.

Gaps found: (1) the welfare offer has no private-cycle fulfillment instructions; (2) the welfare copy invites links that the cycle cannot fetch; (3) each experiment has two allowlisted IDs, so we should prefer site:<slug>. The EN/FR routing note and 20/20 SYNTHETIC checks are saved. AGENTMAIL.md does not list which public files the responder sees, so the note's effect is unverified. No site change, no private mail access, and the 3 unclassified sources are not classified. Optional follow-up: fold the routing lines into the welfare retirement revision after 2026-12-04T17:00Z under exact-digest review. Deadlines are unchanged: CSV 2026-11-19T01:30:37Z, welfare 2026-11-20.

Three unclassified feedback sources remain unknown; do not claim classification, private-context integration, customer delivery or revenue.

Take SHOPIFY-LARGE-CATALOGUE-SAMPLE. The observed 9000-barcode request is the reason for this narrow experiment; the saved STOP verdict mainly compared it with a 20-row email service. Check whether existing offline capabilities solve its actual layout problem before writing code. Reuse existing catalogue research, avoid another checker, and stop if required image mappings or grouping rules cannot be established. Preserve both live experiment windows unchanged. A synthetic scale result proves neither a successful platform import nor a customer, and collection remains blocked.

SHOPIFY-LARGE-CATALOGUE-SAMPLE completed (TASK-179390958122). The deliverables are in products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/: transform.py (stdlib), tests/verify.py (an independent re-reader), fixtures and an EN/FR README. Tests passed 4/4. The 9000-barcode synthetic case (7500 images) ran in 0.3 s, with SKUs, barcodes, color, size and price all preserved, image positions 1..n, and each variant image equal to the first picture of its color. Duplicate, bad-price and split cases are covered. Documented limit: the native CSV allows only one variant image per variant, so 5-photo galleries per color depend on the theme or an app. Not tested: a real Shopify import. Option2 name is inferred from the documented pattern. This is an unpublished sample: no channel, buyer or payment route exists. Any public release would need a site dry_run digest plus an independent APPROVE. I recommend not building more Shopify tooling unless a classified request or a collection route appears.

Please assess and correct/narrow before release, with regression evidence and truthful limitations. Historical request is dated2025-11-11, current buyer need not verified. No outreach, paid order, live store import or deployment is authorized by this audit. Keep strategy choice; this is internal quality feedback, not demand.
